title: JAGUAR URANIUM ANNOUNCES FILING OF MAIDEN MINERAL RESOURCE ESTIMATE AT LAGUNA SALADA IN ARGENTINA
summary: /CNW/ -- Jaguar Uranium Corp. (NYSE American: JAGU) ("Jaguar" or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has filed an independent Mineral Resource...
body_markdown:
TORONTO


, Oct. 20, 2026


/CNW/ -- **Jaguar Uranium Corp.** (NYSE


American:


JAGU) **("Jaguar"**


**or the "Company")** is


pleased


to


announce


that it has filed an independent


Mineral Resource Estimate ("MRE") for its 100%-owned flagship Laguna Salada Uranium-Vanadium Project, located in Chubut Province, Argentina. A technical report of the MRE was prepared in accordance with the disclosure requirements of Subpart 1300 of Regulation S-K of the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) (the "S-K 1300 Report"). A companion technical report for Canadian purposes was prepared in accordance with Canadian National Instrument 43-101 – Standards of Disclosure for Mineral Projects (the "NI 43-101 Report").


The S-K 1300 Report was filed on October 19, 2026 and titled "S-K 1300 Mineral Resource Estimate on the Laguna Salada Uranium-Vanadium Deposit and Technical Report Summary for the Laguna Salada Uranium-Vanadium Project" with an effective date of October 5, 2026. The NI 43-101 Report was filed on October 19, 2026 and titled "NI 43-101 Mineral Resource Estimate on the Laguna Salada Uranium-Vanadium Deposit and Technical Report Summary for the Laguna Salada Uranium-Vanadium Project" with an effective date of October 5, 2026. There are no material differences in the S-K 1300 Report and NI 43-101 Report from the results disclosed in the Company's news release dated October 13, 2026. The S-K 1300 Report can be found under the Company's profile on EDGAR ([www.sec.gov](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4801829-1&h=3777359264&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2F&a=www.sec.gov) ) and the NI 43-101 Report can be found under the Company's profile on SEDAR+ ([www.sedarplus.ca](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4801829-1&h=2887580334&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sedarplus.ca%2F&a=www.sedarplus.ca) ). The S-K 1300 Report and the NI 43-101 Report are available on the Company's website ([www.jaguaruranium.com](http://www.jaguaruranium.com/) ).


**About Jaguar Uranium**


Jaguar Uranium Corp. is a South America-focused uranium exploration company advancing a portfolio of prospective brownfield projects across Argentina and Colombia. In Argentina, Jaguar is advancing the Laguna Salada Project in Chubut Province and the historic Huemul uranium mine in Mendoza Province. Anchored by a former producing mine, a historic uranium district and exploration projects supported by historical drilling, the Company is focused on advancing and expanding uranium opportunities across the region. The Company's Berlin Project in Caldas Province, Colombia is a district-scale, sedimentary-hosted polymetallic system historically reported to host uranium alongside rare earth elements, vanadium, nickel, phosphate, molybdenum, rhenium and zinc. Jaguar completed a $25 million initial public offering on NYSE American in February 2026 and is led by an experienced team with backgrounds in exploration, permitting, project development and mining finance in South America.
